what: Body paragraphs in the section are pale gray (--kf-dim) and photos are black-and-white at 150% brightness, then once the section overlaps the screen even slightly, each step number (data-step) regains its color over 1s at .7s intervals — text and photo with the same number turn on together. An About section where the text fills in dark ink paragraph by paragraph and the photo collage beside it opens its eyes one by one. Once only.

options.gap: Gap between turns (sec), default .7 — section derived from the original metate
options.dur: Time for one cell to regain its color (s), default 1
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text block that turns from gray → ink. Order by data-step (from 1), otherwise by placement
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo that turns from black and white to color. Same data-step means same time

note: The original set gray text to #aeaeae and photos to filter: saturate(0%) brightness(150%), then removed the class and used color 1s ease · filter 1s transitions. The part takes the gray from the skin’s --kf-dim.

from.where: index.html .mt-concept (origin section — five paragraphs · six photos, matching number pairs 1·3·5·2·4·4, original top/js/index.js checkConceptScroll)
